source_fingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted tracked relative paths and contents, NUL separated

tests.changes_after_test_run: Only the replay timing frame width changed from 300 to 360 points. Core and test sources are unchanged. The final app was rebuilt and checked natively.

scope: missing brackets for speed, throttle, brake, and gear
independent_ui_helper_harness.method: Extracted actual production helper bodies, compiled with Swift 6 strict concurrency and warnings as errors. No permanent UI test package added.

recorded_data_benchmark.limitation: Single optimized runs. Excludes drawing, networking, process memory, and energy. No sustained whole-app improvement is established.

passed: 20 recorded cars on the actual race map, synchronized selected-driver telemetry and timing
Timing selection for Hamilton and Vettel; map selection opened Ricciardo inspector
Compact inspector popover and wide side inspector; native stint and conditions disclosures
Concise missing telemetry, lap, and tyre states in the included sample
All five timing columns fit without a horizontal scrollbar at about 981 by 702 points
980-point minimum width with 270-point sidebar; 1300-point inspector breakpoint; 1470 by 924-point wide layout
Library season and session controls, native table, and singular 1 session footer
Actual qualifying comparison with speed, throttle, brake, and gear channels
Q3 Hamilton lap 17 versus Bottas lap 15: +0.112 seconds whole-lap difference
Q1 and Q3 phase filtering confined lap pickers to the selected phase
Replay lap sought the selected completed lap and started playback
Last completed race recording restored paused after app restart
Minimized replay retained play intent; restored cursor stayed near its previous position instead of jumping by the hidden interval
Settings source attribution, storage, and About content inspected without deleting recordings
native_checks.layout_correction: Replay timing frame increased from 300 to 360 points after native observation of a clipped State column.

process_measurements.tool: top, two-second intervals; first sample discarded
process_measurements.condition: Australia 2019 race, wide replay window, Hamilton inspector, 1x playback
process_measurements.memory_metric: macOS top MEM as reported, not an RSS or peak-memory ceiling
process_measurements.conclusion: Paused and minimized activity is near zero. No sustained playback CPU improvement is established.
process_measurements.limitation: Short observations on a host under heavy CPU and memory pressure; no frame-rate or energy measurement.

independent_final_stack_review.conclusion: No identifiable app layout cycle or further rendering defect supported by this sample.
independent_final_stack_review.limitation: Sampling observations are not CPU percentages and do not establish a speedup or regression.

not_exercised: Active chart hover annotation: automation released the selection gesture. Missing-field and boundary helper behavior passed the independent harness.
Native destructive download deletion: no user recordings were removed. Filesystem failures and cancellation pass core tests.
native_checks.previous_interruption: The Mac locked during the earlier attempt. Listed checks completed after manual unlock.

privacy_and_provenance.scope: Tracked snapshot prepared for the single green flag root commit on main.
privacy_and_provenance.limitation: Pattern and manual metadata review, not proof that every string or binary byte is harmless or original. Squashing does not guarantee erasure from backups, reflogs, or server retention.

publication.practical_assessment: No observed source/privacy blocker. Hobby source publication is reasonable if unresolved provider-data risk is accepted.

coverage_limits: Native acceptance covers the listed recordings and sizes. Active hover annotation and destructive native storage operations were not exercised.
Short native process measurements do not establish sustained playback CPU improvement, frame rate, or energy efficiency.
No every-season provider-data fidelity or parity with mature editors is established.
The payload budget is not an RSS ceiling.
No zero account/legal consequence assurance is available.
The app is not Developer ID signed or notarized.

fingerprint_scope_correction.reason: The earlier filesystem fingerprint included one ignored Python bytecode file. These fingerprints cover only tracked inputs, matching a fresh checkout. App source and resources are unchanged.

pre_squash_private_history_scan.limitation: Pattern and manual review, not proof that every string or binary byte is harmless or original.
